headline: Expanse and Nevish Line Burn as Stonecradle Reawakens
war_summary: Evening returns find the Weathered Expanse still the hottest sector with seven changes in two hours and fifty-seven on the day about Wightwalk, Crow's Nest, Shattered Advance and Spirit Watch for two Colonial, two Warden and five ruined holdings, last heard at the hour, with day losses of 5,337 Colonial and 6,237 Warden still quickening. The Nevish Line quickens to five in two hours and forty-three on the day about Blackcoat Way, Blinding Stones and Tomb Father for six Colonial and two Warden holdings, also last at the hour, with day losses near 9,287 Colonial and 11,244 Warden accelerating. Stonecradle rekindles with six in two hours and fourteen on the day about World's End and The Reach, last at 2031, losses accelerating. Linn Mercy and Mooring County have gone quiet in two hours after last reports at 1721 and 1736, while Marban Hollow remains silent since 0346 and Callahan's Passage shows heavy losses with no transfer.
